steps.en: Install it with an LLM-provider extra and set that provider's API key
steps.zh: 装上带大模型服务扩展的包，设好对应的 API key

steps.en: Wrap your agent as a function and write a scenario: inputs plus checks
steps.zh: 把 agent 包成函数，写一个场景：输入加检查

steps.en: Run the scenario from your test code
steps.zh: 在测试代码里运行这个场景

steps.en: Calls your function with the inputs and records the exchange as a trace
steps.zh: 用这些输入调用你的函数，把这次往来记成一条轨迹

steps.en: Grades every check, sending LLM-judge checks such as Groundedness to the judge model
steps.zh: 逐条判定检查，Groundedness 这类裁判检查交给裁判模型打分

steps.en: Prints a pass/fail report per check
steps.zh: 按检查逐条打印通过/失败报告

value.en: A wrong or ungrounded answer becomes a failing test you can rerun after every change, instead of a user screenshot
value.zh: 答错或没有依据的回答变成一条每次改动后都能重跑的失败测试，而不是等用户截图

sources: https://github.com/Giskard-AI/giskard-oss#quickstart (from giskard.checks import Scenario, Groundedness; await scenario.run(); result.print_report(); default judge openai/gpt-4o-mini)
